_comment: The homepage award spotlight. To feature a different product, change `slug` to any platform slug (donordock, 4agoodcause, instrumentl, eleo, monday, jotform...) — pick a featured one and rewrite award/verdict. Everything else on the card (price, link, reader offer) is pulled automatically from the platform page and affiliates.json. Set `show` to false to hide the card. Keep the verdict honest and specific: it is our own editorial pick, not a third-party accreditation.
verdict: One plan, every feature, unlimited contacts. It pays for itself the moment it replaces the CRM, the email tool, and the giving pages you're paying for separately. The ActionBoard turns the database into a daily follow-up list, and there's a 90-day money-back guarantee if it doesn't stick.
